title: A one-dimensional compute workgroup accesses multidimensional images on Arm
heuristic_rationale: Adapted from an upstream API-level check using Godot-visible evidence. It does not prove the Vulkan condition fired or predict saved milliseconds. On the actual Vulkan driver, exactly one fixed local-size dimension exceeds one and the compute entry-point body directly samples, fetches, gathers, reads or writes a 2D/3D/cube/rectangle image. Image declarations alone do not qualify. Helper-only operations, unresolved image values and specialized sizes are skipped. Addressing and tiling are unknown; a one-dimensional group can still have good locality.

title: An imported shader stage exceeds NVIDIA's descriptor-space guideline

On the actual Vulkan driver, known descriptors in one imported stage exceed upstream's 256-byte fast-space guideline: image/sampler descriptors cost four bytes, non-array uniform buffers eight and non-array storage buffers sixteen.
